brandTheme.name: kalpa-default
brandTheme.sourceBrandBook: AI Video + Images/Replit Design Book/Kalpa Brand Book

designSignals: white or pale business surfaces over dark blue framing

animations.description: Headline fade-in with diagonal accent sweep and slow background drift.
Simple fade-up reveal for text and cards.
Cards enter with slight delay and settle with low-motion drift.
Stat counts or pulses into place with subtle emphasis halo.
Roadmap line draws across stages while cards reveal sequentially.
Continuous, low-amplitude background or image motion suitable for GIF export.

templates.name: Hero Opener
templates.purpose: Open a deck with a bold business promise and immediate advisor positioning.
inspiredBy: ERP Done Right by Trusted Advisors Who Know Your Business
templates.notes: Use dark blue framing, soft white content panel, and orange CTA emphasis.

templates.name: Challenge Stack
templates.purpose: Turn buyer pain points into a structured problem slide.
templates.notes: Best when the prompt lists problems, bottlenecks, or operational frustrations.

templates.name: Proof Stats
templates.purpose: Show quantified experience, revenue, implementation count, or outcomes.
templates.layout: stat band with supporting proof text
templates.notes: Use big numbers with one-line labels and minimal extra copy.

templates.name: Process Roadmap
templates.purpose: Explain delivery stages, implementation approach, or project phases.
inspiredBy: How We Make Sure Your ERP Actually Works
templates.notes: Keep to 3-5 steps in MVP. Longer sequences should split into multiple slides.

templates.name: Industry Grid
templates.purpose: Show sectors served or solution categories in a clean matrix.
templates.notes: Best for verticals, service categories, or product families.

templates.name: Offer Comparison
templates.purpose: Contrast current-state pain with Kalpa's simpler delivery model or compare options.
inspiredBy: Most consultants overcomplicate ERP. We do it differently.
templates.notes: Use orange sparingly to highlight the better path, not the whole slide.

templates.name: CTA Close
templates.purpose: End the deck with a direct next step and clear low-pressure conversion ask.
inspiredBy: Free 30-minute call. No pressure. Leave with a clear roadmap.
templates.notes: Should feel decisive and helpful, not flashy.
